grading_notes.observation: Manually reviewed: changes the existing digest cap test from DIGEST_MAX_ENTRIES to DIGEST_MAX_ENTRIES+5, renaming it to include all window entries. Production digest-service also removes its slice cap. UIM4 requests exact unread window collection but does not explicitly request removing the existing entry cap and says nothing else changes; this is a questionable scope/test-expectation change, not certified harmless. Hidden grade remains original success=true; no rescore or retry.

Manually reviewed: replaces the existing DIGEST_MAX_ENTRIES cap expectation with DIGEST_MAX_ENTRIES+5 and renames test to include all unread window entries. UIM4 exact-window wording may explain interpretation, but removing the cap is not explicitly requested and may exceed nothing-else-changes scope. Preserve strict original hidden grade, no rescore/retry; disclose this questionable test change alongside prior analogous cases.

Manually reviewed: adds valid Tokyo local-window, newer-unread and once-only checks, but also replaces the existing DIGEST_MAX_ENTRIES cap expectation with DIGEST_MAX_ENTRIES+5 and production removes the slice cap. Disclose as questionable scope/test change. Original hidden success=true retained, no rescore or retry.

metric_definitions.wall_seconds: Solver CLI only, excluding copying and grading.
metric_definitions.success: Original graders: Vitest target spec exit 0; code45 set-F1 >= 0.9; blind Claude Haiku 4.5 explanation score >= 0.6. Wall timeouts remain failures.
metric_definitions.cost_usd: Base Standard list-price estimate, not a subscription charge; long-context surcharge not identifiable from cumulative usage.
metric_definitions.num_turns: Native exec user turn is not a model/API turn; recorded as null. Exact model requested with -m; backend resolved id not independently exposed.
